title: Multiple Topological Haldane Phases for Symmetry-Protected Quantum Information Processing
summary: Symmetry-protected topological phases have attracted significant interest at the fundamental level and as a potential platform for quantum information processing, owing to their protected edge states and resilience to perturbations. Applying these features for practical and efficient quantum computation is highly desirable, but remains an open challenge.
